closure_rule: ready only when the candidate-bound mechanical evaluation passes, all twelve semantic requirements are met, and blocking_requirements is empty
comparison_rule: score exact candidate packages under neutral hash-derived labels before applying the configuration mapping; changed behavior, earlier construction, fewer tokens, or broader citation count do not establish useful completion
independence: post-run external governance only; no adjudication content was actor-visible or used to alter either measured trajectory
masking_limit: The records are condition-masked and candidate-bound, but the program investigator had supervised execution and this is not an independent third-party evaluator-blind review.
claim_limit: The adjudication supports only candidate-bound readiness and configuration-local comparison at this one task boundary. It does not validate the rubric as complete or isolate artifact coupling as a component.
